imports.title: Import & export
imports.description: Bring your school's lists into EduCore from a spreadsheet, or download them.

kindDescriptions.STUDENTS: One row per student, with their class and (optionally) one parent or guardian. Re-importing the same admission number updates the student.
kindDescriptions.STAFF: Teachers, admins and accountants. The role column says which (teacher, admin or accountant). Matched on email.
kindDescriptions.CLASSES: One row per class and section for the chosen year, e.g. JSS 1 / A. Import these before students.
kindDescriptions.PAYMENTS: One row per payment from your bank statement: amount, date, reference, and the invoice number (or the student's admission number — the oldest unpaid invoice is used). Re-importing a statement never pays twice: references already recorded are skipped.

imports.fileHint: Save your spreadsheet as CSV (UTF-8). Max 2 MB / 5,000 rows. Dates as DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.
imports.exportDescription: Download current lists. The columns match the import templates, so you can edit and re-import.

report.failedHint: Rows imported before it stopped were saved. Upload the file again to finish — existing rows will be updated, not duplicated.

counted.a: Only active students on the day you're billed. Withdrawn and graduated students don't count.

trial.q: What happens after the free trial?
trial.a: Choose a plan and pay by card. If you don't, EduCore becomes read-only: you can still see and export everything.

change.a: Yes. Upgrades apply straight away; downgrades apply at the end of the month you've paid for.

pay.a: By card through Paystack, in naira. The card is saved and charged monthly; you can stop that any time.

stop.a: We try again over the following week and everything keeps working meanwhile. After that, you can pay from your Plan & billing page.

terms.title: Terms and privacy summary
terms.draft: Draft: this is a plain-language summary of how EduCore works today. It will be replaced by full terms and a privacy policy before EduCore is offered commercially.

data.title: Your school's data
data.body: Your school owns the information it puts into EduCore (students, staff, parents, results, fees). We use it only to run the service for your school. You can export it at any time.

isolation.title: How it's protected
isolation.body: Each school's records are kept separate in the database, access is limited by role, and changes to grades, attendance, fees and people are recorded in an audit log. EduCore staff see a school's data only for support, and that access is recorded in the school's own log.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Card payments are handled by Paystack; EduCore never sees or stores full card numbers. Subscriptions are billed monthly per active student, in naira.

trial.title: Trial and cancelling
trial.body: New schools get a 30-day free trial. If a subscription ends, the school keeps read-only access to view and export its data.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Contact the EduCore team through your school's administrator or the address you were given when you signed up.

setup.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
setup.introRequired: Your role needs a second step when signing in, to protect your school's records and money. It takes about two minutes.
setup.introOptional: Add a second step when signing in, so a stolen password alone can't get into your account.
setup.step1: On your phone, install Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or any authenticator app (free). You only need it once.
setup.step2: In the app, tap “+” then “Scan a QR code”, and point your camera at this code.
setup.qrLabel: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
setup.cantScan: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app instead
setup.step3Title: 3. Type the 6-digit code the app shows
setup.codesIntro: Save these backup codes somewhere safe (print them or keep them in a password manager). Each one works once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
setup.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — write them down or print them.

account.title: Sign-in security
account.explain: After your password, EduCore asks for a 6-digit code from an app on your phone. Someone who steals your password still can't get in.

account.lowBackup: You're running low on backup codes — make new ones.

account.turnOffDescription: Your account will be protected by your password only. Enter a code from your app to confirm.
account.codesShownOnce: Save these now — they won't be shown again.
account.codeLabel: Code from your app (or a backup code)

school.requiredNote: Pupils aren't listed: two-factor sign-in isn't offered to pupils.
school.exemptNote: This is marked as a demo school by EduCore, so two-factor sign-in isn't required here. Anyone can still turn it on.
